internal.title: Incident Resolved: Accounting Service Kafka Consumer Lag
internal.body:
At 11:45 UTC, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, indicating a queue backlog issue with a lag of 5200 records. The diagnosis confirmed the backlog as the root cause. A mitigation action was proposed and approved to disable the kafkaQueueProblems flag. This action was executed at 12:05 UTC, and recovery was verified shortly after with the consumer lag returning to normal levels. The incident is now resolved.

Key timeline:
- 11:45:39 Alert received for KafkaConsumerLagHigh
- 12:05:22 Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog in accounting
- 12:05:29 Action to disable kafkaQueueProblems flag approved and executed
- 12:05:29 Recovery verified with normalized consumer lag

No further impact is expected. Monitoring continues to ensure stability.

external.title: Service Interruption: Delays in Accounting Processing
external.body: Between 11:45 and 12:05 UTC, the accounting service experienced delays due to a backlog in message processing. This caused temporary slowdowns in accounting operations. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting internal processing flags, restoring normal service promptly. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
